orchard-drop.title: Orchard Drop â€“ Fruit Merge Puzzle
orchard-drop.open: Drop fruit into the columns and watch matching pieces merge into bigger, juicier fruit. Short levels with a clear goal make it easy to play one more.
bullets: 40 levels, each checked by a solver so it can always be won
Merge 3 or more at once to jump several fruit sizes
Endless mode with a best-score chase
Hammer and hint helpers when a board gets tight
Plays in portrait and landscape, phone or desktop, progress saved
faq: How do I play?
Tap a column to drop the next fruit. Two or more equal fruits that touch merge into the next fruit.
What is the goal of a level?
Make the fruit shown in the goal card before you run out of drops.
Is every level possible?
Yes. Every level was played through by a solver before release.
Does it save my progress?
Yes, on your device (and in your portal account where the portal supports it).
Are there ads during play?
No. Ads only show between levels, and helper videos are always optional.

gem-kiln.title: Gem Kiln â€“ Merge Gems, Break the Stones
gem-kiln.open: Merge falling gems next to the old stones to crack them open. Every level is a small tactical puzzle you can finish in a minute.
bullets: 40 stone-breaking levels, all verified solvable
Merges crack every stone they touch â€“ plan your chains
Calm night palette with twelve hand-drawn gem tiers
Endless mode for long sessions
One-tap controls on phone, mouse or keyboard on desktop
faq: How do stones break?
Any merge that touches a stone breaks it.
Can I move a stone?
No, stones stay in place. Tiles above them rest on them.
What if I run out of drops?
Try again, or watch an optional video for five more drops.
Is every level possible?
Yes. A solver finished every level before release.
Does it work offline?
Once loaded, the game runs without a connection.

orbit-stack.title: Orbit Stack â€“ Merge Planets, Fill Orders
orbit-stack.open: Drop moons, comets and worlds into the sky and merge them into ringed giants and stars. Each level asks for a set of planets â€“ make them before the drops run out.
bullets: 40 order levels, every one solver-verified
Twelve space tiers from pebble to galaxy
Chain merges count toward the order
Endless mode with rising tiers
Portrait and landscape, phone and desktop
faq: What is an order?
A number of tiles of a tier (or higher) you must create by merging.
Do bigger tiles count?
Yes, any merge at or above the asked tier counts.
How do merges chain?
When tiles fall after a merge they can merge again, and each one counts.
Is there a time limit?
No. You have a number of drops, not a timer.
Is my progress saved?
Yes, on this device and in your portal account where supported.

bento-drop.title: Bento Drop â€“ Merge Snacks, Melt the Ice
bento-drop.open: Merge rice balls, dumplings and sweets next to frozen snacks to melt them free. Clear all the ice in a few smart drops.
bullets: 40 ice levels, each one checked by a solver
Thawed snacks fall and can chain into new merges
Twelve food tiers up to a full bento box
Endless mode for a high score
Bright, flat art that reads well on small screens
faq: How does ice melt?
Any merge that touches an ice block melts it. The snack inside is then free to fall and merge.
Can frozen snacks merge?
Not until the ice melts.
How long is a level?
Most take under two minutes.
Is every level possible?
Yes, every level was solved by a solver before release.
Are there ads during play?
No. Ads only appear between levels; helper videos are optional.

critter-tower.title: Critter Tower â€“ Merge Cute Animals
critter-tower.open: Drop chicks, bunnies and pups on a busy tower and merge them up to lions and whales. Hit the score target with smart chains before the drops run out.
bullets: 40 score levels with ready-made starting towers
Every level verified by a solver
Twelve animal tiers drawn as friendly flat faces
Endless mode with a best-score chase
One-tap play, portrait or landscape
faq: How do I score?
Every merge scores points; bigger animals score much more.
Why does the tower start full?
Each level starts from a set tower, so you plan around what is already there.
What happens when the tower is full?
The level ends. An optional video can clear the top rows once.
Is every level possible?
Yes, a solver finished each level first.
Is it for kids?
It is a general-audience puzzle with no chat, no data collection and no in-app purchases.
